description: Read one saved competitor ad in full, with its stored decode (the ad's formula and a recreation prompt) when it has one. Costs no credits; never runs a decode. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

ad_id.description: A saved ad's id, from list_saved_ads or save_competitor_ad.

name: get_saved_ad

ad_ref.description: Opaque reference to the ad's source listing; copy it back unchanged when saving. Null when the source gave none.

ad_url.description: The public listing or post, when known.

decoded.description: True when a decode is stored; get_saved_ad returns it.

demo.description: True for a sample row: not a real ad. Never present a sample as live data.

estimated_spend.description: As reported by the source, e.g. a monthly range; absent for most platforms.

id.description: The saved ad's id; pass it as ad_id.

media_url.description: The creative (video or image), when the source exposes one.

running_days.description: Days the ad has been running, when known.

decode.description: The ad's formula, layer by layer, plus a generation-ready prompt.

layers.description: hook { pattern, first2s }, script { skeleton[], tone }, scenes { shotCount, medianCutSec, aspect, timeline[] }, audio { voStyle, pace, musicRole }, cta { pattern, placementSec?, urgencyDevice? }, style { visualElement, palette?, typography?, energy }.

recreationPrompt.description: A 150-300 word prompt that recreates the ad's structure with a different product.
